main.description: A post in a book club discussion, stored in the author's repo inside the club's space. Threading follows the shared threads draft: every post names the `thread` it belongs to, and a reply also names the post it answers in `replyTo`. A top-level post carries no `replyTo`, which is how a reader tells the opening and the later top-level posts from the answers. Linear readers ignore `replyTo` beyond the root; tree readers rebuild the tree from it. The space, not the record, is the access boundary.

content.description: Optional structured body: one HTML document, identified by its `$type` (`net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.richText`, carrying an `html` string restricted to `p`, `br`, `ul`, `ol`, `li`, `blockquote`, `strong`, `em`, `u`, `s`, `span[data-spoiler]`, `a` carrying only an absolute http(s) `href` (serialized with `target="_blank"` and a `rel` that removes the referrer), and `livtet-user` carrying only the `did` of the mentioned actor; no other element and no other attribute is read). `textContent` remains the plain-text fallback and the only thing a reader needs; a spoiler run is written there as an ellipsis.

createdAt.description: Client-declared timestamp when the post was created.

langs.description: Human language of the text, BCP 47 tags.

replyTo.description: The net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.bookClub.post this one answers, in the same thread and space. Absent on a top-level post.

spoiler.description: Marks the body as a spoiler. A reader sees a placeholder instead of the text until they choose to reveal it, and the app withholds `textContent` from the rendering data rather than leaving it in the page for a client to hide.

textContent.description: The post body, as plain text. Empty is allowed only when the post is a reply marker; a discussion post normally has text.

thread.description: The net.olamaelcu.livtet.biblio.bookClub.thread this post belongs to — the root of the discussion. A plain at-uri rather than a strongRef: grouping compares the uri, so an edited thread keeps one discussion.
